nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "flag", "text": "### Batches and grids

One **Run** makes nine images: every outfit against every time of day, with the same hero and place, laid out as a labelled XY plot. The lists come with this workflow.

| Key | Step |
|---|---|
| `Alt+1` | Sweep every combination |
| `Alt+2` | A prompt and a label per frame |
| `Alt+3` | One click, nine images |
| `Alt+4` | Quick preview |
| `Alt+5` | The grid |

:pi-bookmark: Jump with the keys or the **Bookmarks** dock (top bar).

:pi-images: More ways to batch: [Make variations](docs:howto-variations){button pi-images}

---

**Questions, ideas, packs to share:**

[Discord](https://discord.gg/BFYR9WQdVR){button pi-discord #5865f2} [Community packs](https://wp.dumiflex.dev){button pi-globe #22c55e} [Wiki](https://github.com/DumiFlex/ComfyUI-Wildcard-Pipeline/wiki){button pi-github #8b949e} [About these examples](docs:howto-examples){button pi-th-large}", "color": "", "bookmark": null}

nodes.title: Quick preview
widgets_values:
{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "bolt", "text": "**WP Toggles** in *Pick one* mode: pick **Quick** for a fast, rough pass of the whole grid, **Full** for the real thing.

- The pick's value goes to `$steps`; **Var → Int** hands it to the sampler.
- Each choice also writes its own true / false: **Var → Bool** reads `$quick_preview` and the **If/Else Switch** picks the smaller latent.

:pi-arrow-down-left: Wire a Context into its `upstream` and that Context can pick for you: `$steps` = `Quick`.
